[If you are planning a programme, evaluation, bid, or investment that needs robust evidence on social or environmental change, I would be glad to discuss it.]{.lede}

I take on independent evaluations, MEL design, geospatial analysis, and outcome measurement for development programmes and their funders, and for businesses working on nature and climate. It is helpful to include a short note on the project and its timeline, and on what you need the evidence to show.
